d:
Bihar ke mujaphpharpur rajkiy jila skul ke chhatr arnav kumar pichhle do dinon se sham ki kaksha men parhne aa rahe hain. unhonne bataya ki ve pahle ganit ki parhaee ke lie dusri koching men jate the, lekin yahan nishulk koching ki jankari milne par pita ko bataya aur purani koching chhor di.
